sources.title: qwen3-coder-flash
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026: exact hosted model card still says qwen3-coder-flash is functionally equivalent to qwen3-coder-flash-2025-07-28. Text-only coding/tool-interaction model with 1,000,000-token context. It does not disclose a later alias replacement, parameter change, pruning, distillation, expert expansion or added modality. Regional Function Calling tables differ. Web extraction exceeded its size limit; original page HTML was retrieved and parsed directly.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026: Global and International release tables date qwen3-coder-flash and its July 28 snapshot to July 29, 2025; another regional entry is August 5. No later Flash snapshot or structural replacement was identified in this lifecycle page. The separately listed open qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct release is July 31.

sources.title: Text generation
sources.evidence: The exact Qwen3-Coder Flash legacy row marks thinking mode and function calling Supported. This conflicts with the baseline reasoning=false; the detailed card does not state a thinking mode.

sources.title: Deep thinking
sources.evidence: Dedicated thinking documentation describes reasoning_content and supported model families; it does not explicitly identify qwen3-coder-flash.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-Flash release announcement, July 31, 2025
sources.evidence: Official Qwen post begins "Qwen3-Coder-Flash: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct" and describes 256K native context extendable to 1M with YaRN. This is an explicit developer identification, stronger than family resemblance. Direct X retrieval returned 403; original post text and author/date were read through https://publish.twitter.com/oembed?url=https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/1950925444057792808 on October 27, 2026.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Developer model overview explicitly reports 30.5B total and 3.3B activated parameters, with 128 experts and 8 activated experts. It describes text generation, 256K native context extended to 1M with YaRN, and non-thinking output. These are the published nominal counts of the model explicitly identified as Coder-Flash in s5, not a claim of a tensor census of the hosted service.

sources.title: Qwen Flash API release announcement, August 5, 2025
sources.evidence: Official Qwen post announces Flash APIs supporting Qwen3-Coder and Qwen3-2507, both with 1M context, and specifically names Qwen3-Coder-Flash. This corroborates the connection between the Flash model announcement and the hosted API. Read original text and author/date through https://publish.twitter.com/oembed?url=https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/1952767585596145773 on October 27, 2026.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct configuration
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, model_type qwen3_moe, 48 layers, 128 experts and 8 experts per token. Supports the MoE correction associated with the nominal model identity. Configuration only was downloaded, not weight shards.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder repository README
sources.evidence: Current README reopened October 27, 2026 lists Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct and its FP8 variant, alongside separate 480B and Next models. It does not identify Flash as a structurally changed or newly replaced model. Fresh first-party searches across Qwen and Alibaba sources found no conflicting nominal parameter disclosure or documented structural change for the exact Flash alias.

name.note: Normalized display name of the documented API identifier.

developer.note: Official Alibaba Cloud Qwen model documentation.

release_date.note: First explicit Global/International release date; July 28 is the snapshot date, not the listed service release date.

open_weights.note: Qwen explicitly identifies Flash with the published Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct nominal model, supporting parameter and architecture inference. Exact equivalence of the currently served checkpoint to downloadable weights remains unverified; retain the hosted-alias weight-status assessment.

license.note: No model-weight license disclosed for this hosted alias; do not transfer a related checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal total inferred from explicit developer identity: Qwen calls Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct Qwen3-Coder-Flash, and its card reports 30.5B. Current API documentation still maps Flash to the July 28 snapshot; no pruning, distillation, expert expansion, modality addition or alias replacement was disclosed in checked first-party sources. This supports the model specification without asserting exact hosted tensor identity.

active_parameters_b.note: The explicitly identified model card independently reports 3.3B activated parameters; this is not calculated from total parameters or the A3B name. Applied to Flash as a nominal inference from the developer identity. The model has 128 experts with 8 selected per token.

architecture.note: Developer identification of Flash as Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct supports MoE lineage; its configuration explicitly uses Qwen3MoeForCausalLM with 8 of 128 experts activated per token. No contradictory structural change was identified.

context_window.note: Explicit context window; 997,952 is the separate maximum input length.

reasoning.note: Official exact-row overview marks thinking supported, but the dedicated thinking documentation does not identify this legacy alias and the now-identified open model card explicitly says non-thinking. Preserve unresolved hosted reasoning status because the official capability conflict remains.

tool_call.note: Multi-turn tool interaction and function calling confirmed; detailed regional tables disagree on availability outside Beijing.

patch.description: Qwen3-based code generation model for repository understanding and multi-turn tool interaction.
patch.notes: 30.5B total and 3.3B activated are nominal counts inferred from Qwen's explicit identification of Coder-Flash as Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, a MoE model. Alibaba still maps the API alias to its July 28 snapshot; Global/International service release was July 29, 2025. Exact served-checkpoint weight equivalence remains unverified. Official thinking-mode and regional function-calling documentation conflict.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit establishes nominal 30.5B total, 3.3B activated and MoE through Qwen's explicit July 31 identification of Coder-Flash as Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct plus that model's developer card/configuration. Reopened original Flash/API announcements, current hosted model card, lifecycle history and developer repository; searched first-party sources for newer disclosures and structural changes. Current alias remains tied to the July 28 snapshot, with no conflicting count or documented structural replacement found. Preserve July 29 service release, 1M hosted context and other original assessments. Exact hosted weight equivalence/license and conflicting thinking-mode documentation remain unresolved; absence of a hosted tensor census does not erase the supported nominal counts.
